services.desc: Adults who are interested in getting started in karate are welcome to join any of the Beginners classes indicated in our class schedule. Some are designated as “Youth and Adult” which will have a mix of ages, and are great for families who would like to train together. The “Adult” beginner classes are only for adults, which may be preferred by some. We welcome adults of all fitness levels. Give it a try! See trial class opportunities. Returning Students Enso welcomes students who are interested in continuing their training in Shotokan or transitioning from a different martial arts style.
